meta.title: The Final Challenge
meta.structure: 3 islands x 6 skills = 18 stations, plus 3 seals and 1 Final Gate

gating.previewScope: one sample station per island, 3 items, never scored, never stored

scoring.stationScore: percentage of items correct, for feedback and review only
scoring.skillScore: pooled across the Final Gate only
scoring.note: The certificate reads the Final Gate only. Station and seal results never enter the overall.

certificate.claim: Aligned to A2 descriptors. Does not certify a CEFR level.
rules: A skill below 50 forces pending, whatever the overall is
Never print a percentage on the certificate
A retake never downgrades an issued certificate
Only a teacher may move pending to issued

meta.contentPolicy: Original review material written for this course. Draws on the vocabulary, grammar and texts of the nine unit packs; no coursebook wording or audio is reproduced.

islands.title: The Market Island
islands.subtitle: Everything you learned about food, clothes and taste

stations.title: The Market Stall
stations.prompt: Choose the word that matches. Every question mixes all three units.

items.sentence: This lemon is very ___. My face hurts!

items.why: The others are things that grow. Popcorn is made from corn.

items.sentence: My sweatshirt is too ___ for summer. It is very hot.

items.why: The others are taste words. Pizza is a food.

stations.title: The Changing Room
stations.prompt: One mistake in each sentence. Tap the wrong word.

items.sentence: She like pizza very much.
items.why: She takes likes.

items.sentence: They doesn't eat carrots.
items.why: They takes don't.

items.sentence: He ___ a blue sweatshirt today.
items.why: He takes is wearing.

items.sentence: My friends is wearing jeans.
items.why: My friends is plural, so use are.

items.sentence: ___ she want a glass of lemonade?
items.why: She takes Does.
So + do agrees with a positive I sentence.

stations.title: The Kitchen Radio
stations.prompt: Listen and answer. Two replays per item.

items.audio: For lunch I had a cheese sandwich and some lemonade.
items.q: What did the speaker drink?

items.audio: My brother doesn't like carrots, but he loves popcorn.
items.q: What does the brother love?

items.audio: Today I am wearing a red sweatshirt, blue jeans and white sneakers.
items.q: What colour are the sneakers?

items.audio: This soup is very salty. Can I have some water, please?
items.q: How does the soup taste?

stations.title: The Party Note
stations.prompt: Read the note. Then answer the questions.
stations.passage: Hi Sara, It's my birthday on Saturday! Please come at four o'clock. We are having pizza and lemonade in the garden. My mum is making a big chocolate cake, so don't eat too much before you come! It's hot this week, so wear something light. Don't wear your new jeans — we are playing games on the grass. I am wearing my yellow dress and my new white sneakers. Can you bring your sister? Say yes! See you Saturday, Nia

items.q: What is the note about?
options: An invitation to a birthday party
items.answer: An invitation to a birthday party

items.q: What time is the party?
Why should Sara NOT wear her new jeans?
options: They are playing games on the grass
items.answer: They are playing games on the grass

items.q: What is Nia wearing?
options: A yellow dress and white sneakers
items.answer: A yellow dress and white sneakers

items.q: Tap the sentence that gives a reason about the weather.
items.answer: It's hot this week, so wear something light.
items.why: That sentence connects the weather to what to wear.

stations.title: The Order Pad
stations.prompt: Build each sentence, then write your own.

items.answer: She likes sweet food but she doesn't like carrots.

items.wrong: He want a glass of lemonade, and they doesn't want pizza.
items.answer: He wants a glass of lemonade, and they don't want pizza.

items.prompt: Write three sentences: what you like to eat, what you don't like, and what you are wearing today.

stations.title: The Café Counter
stations.prompt: Answer each question in a full sentence. Record each one separately.

items.q: What is your favourite food, and why?
What are you wearing today?
Does your friend like sweet food? Ask and answer.
Talk for 30 seconds about a meal you like. Say what it is, how it tastes, and who you eat it with.

seal.title: The Market Seal
seal.prompt: Six questions. One for each skill. Pass with four correct to open the next island.

items.sentence: He ___ popcorn, but he doesn't like cheese.

items.audio: I want a pizza and a glass of lemonade, please.
items.q: What does the speaker want to drink?
In the party note, what is Nia's mum making?
Say one sentence about what you like to eat.

islands.title: The Neighbourhood Island
islands.subtitle: Everything you learned about school, rooms and weather

stations.title: The Street Map
stations.prompt: Choose the word that matches. Every question mixes all three units.

items.sentence: I put my books in my ___ and go to class.

items.why: The others are rooms inside a house. A garden is outside.

items.sentence: It's very cold. Don't forget your ___.

items.why: The others are weather words. A classroom is a place.

stations.title: The Lost Property Box
stations.prompt: One mistake in each sentence. Tap the wrong word.

items.sentence: She have art on Monday.
items.why: She takes has.

items.sentence: Does he has a calculator?
items.why: After Does the verb loses its -s.

items.sentence: Where ___ the buckets? They're in the garden.
items.why: Buckets is plural, so use are.

items.sentence: The toothbrush are in the bathroom.
items.why: One toothbrush takes is.

items.sentence: ___ it hot today? Yes, it is.
items.why: Weather takes It is, so the question is Is it.

items.instruction: Give the instruction for cold weather.
items.why: An imperative uses the base verb with no -s.

stations.title: The Weather Report
stations.prompt: Listen and answer. Two replays per item.

items.audio: On Monday I have maths first, then English, then art in the afternoon.
items.q: What does the speaker have in the afternoon?

items.audio: The buckets are in the garden, and the cushions are on the sofa.
items.q: Where are the cushions?

items.audio: It's rainy and cold today, so put on your coat and take your umbrella.
items.q: What should you take?

items.audio: My sister doesn't have a ruler, but she has two erasers.
items.q: How many erasers does she have?

stations.title: The Saturday List
stations.prompt: Read the list and the message. Then answer the questions.
stations.passage: SATURDAY — THINGS TO DO 1. Find the buckets. They are not in the garden. 2. Put the cushions on the sofa. 3. My school bag is under the table. Take out my calculator and my ruler. 4. It's foggy this morning, so we can't go to the park. Mum says it will be sunny in the afternoon. 5. Don't put on your new shoes — the grass is wet. 6. Ask Dad where the umbrella is. He always knows. From, Dita

items.q: What is this text?
options: A list of jobs for Saturday
items.answer: A list of jobs for Saturday

items.q: Where are the buckets NOT?
Why can't they go to the park in the morning?
Why should they not wear new shoes?
Tap the sentence that tells you where the school bag is.
items.answer: My school bag is under the table.
items.why: That sentence names the object and its place.

stations.title: The Noticeboard
stations.prompt: Build each sentence, then write your own.

items.answer: My brother has science on Tuesday.

items.wrong: Does she has a calculator, and the toothbrush are in the bathroom.
items.answer: Does she have a calculator, and the toothbrush is in the bathroom.

items.prompt: Write three sentences: what classes you have, where one school thing is, and what to wear in today's weather.
checklist: Correct Put on / Don't put on

stations.title: The Corner Shop
stations.prompt: Answer each question in a full sentence. Record each one separately.

items.q: What classes do you have this week?
Where are three things in your bedroom?
What is the weather like today, and what should you wear?
Talk for 30 seconds about your school day. Say what classes you have, what you carry, and what the weather was like.

seal.title: The Neighbourhood Seal
seal.prompt: Six questions. One for each skill. Pass with four correct to open the last island.

items.sentence: Where ___ my eraser? It's on the desk.

items.audio: It's sunny and hot, so don't put on your coat.
items.q: What does the speaker say NOT to do?
In the Saturday list, who always knows where the umbrella is?
Say one sentence about the weather today.

islands.title: The Summit Island
islands.subtitle: Everything you learned about seasons, houses and places

stations.title: The Trailhead
stations.prompt: Choose the word that matches. Every question mixes all three units.

items.sentence: In the fall we ___ leaves into a big pile.
Was the lake ___? It went very far down.

items.why: The others are uncountable. Tree is countable.
The others are things inside a house or a ger.

stations.title: The Old Map
stations.prompt: One mistake in each sentence. Tap the wrong word.

items.sentence: She go skating in the winter.
items.why: Go becomes goes for she.

items.sentence: Does he goes camping in the summer?
items.why: After Does the verb loses its -s.

items.sentence: There ___ three chairs in the kitchen.
items.why: Three chairs is plural, so use are.

items.sentence: The stereo is next the dresser.
items.why: We say next to, with the word to.

items.sentence: There ___ two hills behind the lake.
items.why: Two hills is plural and the sentence is in the past.

items.sentence: Was the trees very old?
items.why: Trees is plural, so the question takes Were.

stations.title: The Ranger's Radio
stations.prompt: Listen and answer. Two replays per item.

items.audio: In the winter my brother goes skating, but I go sledding.
items.q: What does the speaker do in the winter?

items.audio: There are two beds next to the dressers, and there is a mirror behind the door.
items.q: Where is the mirror?

items.audio: There was a lake and there were two hills, but there wasn't an island.
items.q: What was NOT there?

items.audio: The tree was over two thousand years old and very tall.
items.q: How old was the tree?

stations.title: The Ranger's Letter
stations.prompt: Read the letter. Then answer the questions.
stations.passage: Dear Class, Thank you for your visit to our park last week. I hope you enjoyed the trail. Many of you asked about the old tree near the lake. It is over two thousand years old, and it was already here when the first people lived in this valley. In the winter there is snow on the hills, so the trail is closed. In the summer it is warm and the lake is deep enough to swim in. There is a small island in the middle of the lake, and there are two short trees on it. There is also a wooden house next to the ranger station. Inside there is a stove, a table and some chairs. Please come back in the spring, when the flowers come out. Yours, Ranger Dita

items.q: What is the letter about?
options: A thank-you note after a school visit
A warning about a closed road
A shopping list for the park
items.answer: A thank-you note after a school visit

items.q: Why is the trail closed in the winter?
options: There is snow on the hills
items.answer: There is snow on the hills

items.q: What is on the small island?
What is inside the wooden house?
options: A stove, a table and chairs
items.answer: A stove, a table and chairs

items.q: Tap the sentence that tells you when to come back.
items.answer: Please come back in the spring, when the flowers come out.
items.why: That sentence gives the time and the reason.

stations.title: The Visitor's Book
stations.prompt: Build each sentence, then write your own.

items.answer: Neither of the hills was very high.

items.wrong: There were a lake, and she go skating in the winter.
items.answer: There was a lake, and she goes skating in the winter.

items.prompt: Write three sentences: one season activity, one thing in a room and where it is, and one thing that was somewhere you visited.

stations.title: The Lookout
stations.prompt: Answer each question in a full sentence. Record each one separately.

items.q: What does your family do in each season?
What is in your favourite room, and where?
Where were you last weekend, and what was there?
Talk for 30 seconds about a place you would like to visit. Say where it is, what is there, and what you would do there.

seal.title: The Summit Seal
seal.prompt: Six questions. One for each skill. Pass with four correct to open the Final Gate.

items.sentence: Neither of the windows ___ open.

items.audio: There was a beach, but there weren't any birds.
items.q: What was NOT there?
In the ranger's letter, how old is the old tree?

items.answer: There were two hills behind the lake.

items.q: Say one sentence about a season you like.

finalGate.title: The Final Gate
finalGate.prompt: Twenty questions across all nine units. No hints. Take your time.

items.sentence: She ___ a glass of lemonade.

items.q: In the party note, why should Sara not wear her new jeans?
options: They are playing games on the grass
items.answer: They are playing games on the grass

items.audio: The buckets are in the garden, and the cushions are on the sofa.
items.q: Where are the buckets?

items.answer: Does he have science on Monday?

items.sentence: The toothbrush are in the bathroom.
It's cold and windy, so put on your ___ before we go out.

items.q: In the Saturday list, why can't they go to the park in the morning?

items.audio: There was a lake and there were two hills, but there wasn't an island.
items.q: What was NOT there?

items.wrong: There were a lake, and she go skating in the winter.
items.answer: There was a lake, and she goes skating in the winter.

items.sentence: Neither of the windows ___ open.

items.q: In the ranger's letter, tap the sentence that tells you what is inside the wooden house.
items.answer: Inside there is a stove, a table and some chairs.

items.why: The others are uncountable.

items.q: What is your favourite food, and why?
Describe your room. What is in it and where?
What do you do in the summer, and what does someone in your family do?
Tell me about a place you visited. What was there?
Talk for 45 seconds about your week: what you are wearing today, what classes you have, and what the weather is like.

certificate.title: Certificate of Completion
certificate.statement: has completed all nine units and the Final Challenge of a nine-unit English course.
certificate.subtitle: Aligned to A2 descriptors of the Common European Framework
certificate.schoolNameSource: settings.schoolName, defaulting to the app name

verificationCode.algorithm: sha256(learnerName + issueDate + overall), first 8 chars, uppercased, grouped in fours
verificationCode.note: Deterministic, so re-issuing the same learner produces the same code.

selfCheckLine.showWhen: any Phase 7 self-assessment exists for this learner
selfCheckLine.template: On their final self-check they rated {skill} '{rating}'; their work showed '{band}'.

canDoStatements: I can talk about food I like and do not like.
I can describe what people are wearing.
I can order food and say how it tastes.
I can talk about my classes and what I carry to school.
I can say where things are in a house.
I can describe the weather and say what to wear.
I can talk about the four seasons and what people do in them.
I can describe the rooms in a home.
I can talk about a place I visited and what was there.
I can ask and answer questions about the past.
I can read a short text and find the information I need.
I can speak for half a minute about my own life.
mustNotClaim: A percentage anywhere a parent would read it as a grade

printStyles.note: Render with @media print only. No PDF library. One page.

actions.label: Release certificate
actions.effect: outcome becomes issued, releasedBy recorded, certificateId generated

actions.label: Return for retake
actions.effect: outcome becomes not_issued, note visible to learner next visit

bulkAction.label: Release all above 65%
bulkAction.guard: still applies the 50% skill floor per learner

teacherMode.export: CSV: learner, date, overall, six skills, outcome, certificate id

unlockRules.stationLockedReason: Complete Unit {n} to unlock this station
unlockRules.sealLockedReason: Complete all six stations on this island to reach the seal
unlockRules.finalGateLockedReason: Pass all three seals to open the Final Gate
